history.body: Hi, I saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a home for ourselves, and we have two school-age children who each need a separate bedroom. Is Pearl practical for a family like ours? I also saw a dated starting-price reference of around RM302k, which may be within our range.

Yes, on paper it could suit your family. The Phase 1 Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, so it could give each child a separate bedroom and leave a third for you; it would be worth checking the actual floor plan and room dimensions. There’s also a planned SK/SMK school building in the development, expected to complete with Phase 1, though that doesn’t guarantee admission. Your roughly RM302k reference aligns with a dated indicative calculation of RM301,760 for a specific unit category and package—not a confirmed current offer or an all-in price. I’ll check the latest applicable pricing. If helpful, a viewing could let you assess the layout in person; would you like me to help arrange one?

That sounds more promising, especially having three bedrooms for the four of us. I’d like to understand the room arrangement and sizes before deciding whether to visit. Could you share the floor plan? The school building is a plus, though I’d want to check where it is and how it fits our daily route.

That makes sense—the actual room arrangement and sizes are worth checking before you decide whether to visit. The Type A concept shows an entrance foyer, open-plan living/dining/kitchen, three bedrooms and a small storage area. The two secondary bedrooms are shown with two windows each, but I don’t have the approved floor plan or exact room dimensions to share here, so I don’t want to guess. The planned SK/SMK building faces Plot 2 and is not directly in front of the residential towers. I don’t have verified access-route details to say how it would fit your daily routine, so I’ll check the official Type A plan and a site plan showing the school and access.
